description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively processing large batches of work in a non-blocking manner, utilizing requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallbacks. It includes functionality to start, cancel, and monitor progress of batch processing, useful for UI operations such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates an object to manage progressive batch processing, allowing start, cancel, and progress tracking using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps around createProgressiveExpandController to manage UI state and provide methods to start, cancel, and track progress during batch processing.
